{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicate patient_id
print(f"Number of unique patient_id: {df['patient_id'].nunique()}")
print(f"Total rows: {len(df)}")
print(f"Number of duplicate patient_id: {len(df) - df['patient_id'].nunique()}")

# Check for -999 in biomarker_baseline
df_negative_999 = df[df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999]
print(f"Number of rows with biomarker_baseline == -999: {len(df_negative_999)}")
print(f"Proportion: {len(df_negative_999) / len(df):.2%}")"}
